scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --workspace backend run dev" "npm --workspace frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace backend run build && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.setup:python-train: python3 -m venv training/.venv && training/.venv/bin/pip install -r training/requirements.txt
scripts.setup:python-train:gpu: python3 -m venv training/.venv && training/.venv/bin/pip install -r training/requirements-gpu.txt
